def rot_from_to(v, u):
    v = v/np.linalg.norm(v); u = u/np.linalg.norm(u)
    axis = np.cross(v,u); s = np.linalg.norm(axis); c = np.dot(v,u)
    if s < 1e-9:
        if c > 0: return np.eye(3)
        # 180 deg: pick perpendicular axis
        a = np.array([1.,0,0]) if abs(v[0])<0.9 else np.array([0,1.,0])
        axis = np.cross(v,a); axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis); s,c = 1.0,-1.0
    else:
        axis = axis/s
    K = np.array([[0,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3) + s*K + (1-c)*(K@K)

    R = rot_from_to(np.array([1,0,0]),np.array([1,0,0]))  # placeholder
    axis = np.asarray(axis,float); axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
    c,s = np.cos(ang), np.sin(ang)
    K = np.array([[0,-axis[2],axis[1]],[axis[2],0,-axis[0]],[-axis[1],axis[0],0]])

    return (pts-pivot)@R.T + pivot

tP  = np.array([-2.45,0,0.0])        # phosphorus
